newsitem.title: USA: Howell sets sale agreement with Oxford.
newsitem.headline: Howell sets sale agreement with Oxford.

text.p: Howell Industries Inc said Wednesday it signed a definitive agreement under which privately held Oxford Automotive Inc will pay $37 a share in cash for the 622,738 outstanding shares of Howell.

Howell makes structural stampings for the auto industry at plants in Ohio and Michigan, and has annual sales of about $80 million. Oxford is based in Bloomfield Hills, Mich., and had fiscal 1997 sales of $350 million. It makes engineered metal components, assemblies and modules.
The deal is subject to shareholder approval and other conditions.
Oxford Chairman Selwyn Isakow said the purchase expands the firm's relationships with Ford Motor Co and Chrysler Corp and builds on its expertise in suspension-related components for light trucks.
Oxford subsidiaries include Butler Metal Products and Lobdell Emery Corp. It operates eight manufacturing facilities.
